text.p: Salacgriva 95 fish cannery approved a 1997 budget with profits 20 percent lower than 1996 and decided to pay a 15 santime dividend for 1996.
Salacgriva plans to earn 102,938 lats of profit against 213,117 lats in 1996, a shareholder told Reuters after a shareholder meeting on Saturday.
Shareholders decided to pay 79,039 lats in dividends equal to 15 santimes per share.
The company sees lower profits due to increased competition from Latvian, Estonian and Russian producers.
More than 80 percent of Salacgriva produce is exported to Russia and other CIS countries.
Shareholders also decided to transfer 10,656 lats into reserves and invest 102,938 lats in the company's production facilities.
The Salacgriva 95 management also told the meeting about a $400,000 loan taken from Unibanka at 18.5 percent with a repayment period of six years.
The company said the aim of this loan was to increase volumes and lower expenses.
